def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    van_patches = image_patch.find("van")
    parking_area_patches = image_patch.find("parking area")
    
    if not van_patches or not parking_area_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    front_parking_area = min(parking_area_patches, key=lambda pa: pa.vertical_center)
    
    in_front_vans = [v for v in van_patches if is_in_front_of(v, front_parking_area)]
    
    return in_front_vans[0] if in_front_vans else van_patches[0]
